تقتضبي (form VIII)
# تَقْتَضِبِي (taqtaḍibī) /taq.ta.dˤi.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
# تُقْتَضَبِي (tuqtaḍabī) /tuq.ta.dˤa.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
